title: Moon Phases and Eclipses
summary: Why the Moon changes shape over 29.5 days, Amavasya and Purnima, and how solar and lunar eclipses happen.

ib.note: Tidal forces and orbital mechanics follow in DP

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 12: Earth, Moon, and the Sun
Curiosity Ch 11: Keeping Time with the Skies

objectives: I can explain the phases of the Moon using the positions of the Sun, Earth and Moon.
I can name the phases in order, including Amavasya and Purnima.
I can explain solar and lunar eclipses, and why they don’t happen every month.
misconceptions: The phases are caused by Earth’s shadow falling on the Moon.
The Moon makes its own light.
There is an eclipse every new and full moon.
